title: Impact - BaSuka Energy
metaDescription: BaSuka Energy's verified impact: 130 MW generation foundation, 1,200t CO2 avoided, 500+ households powered, women-led operations. IoT-tracked ESG metrics across economic, environmental, and social pillars in Burkina Faso.

sections.heading: Measurable from day one
sections.body: BaSuka Energy is a data driven infrastructure company. Every target below is IoT-verified and tracked in real time – giving investors and climate partners high-fidelity ESG metrics in the Sahel.

sections.heading: Reliable power. Inclusive growth. Long-term value.
sections.intro: BaSuka's approach combines dependable generation, workforce development, smart infrastructure, storage, and clean mobility to create durable national value.

items.label: Power for the grid, industry, and communities
Smart-grid distribution, storage, mobility, and services
Training in safety, site operations, and customer engagement

sections.heading: Built around global goals
sections.intro: BaSuka directly addresses four UN Sustainable Development Goals through its core operating model – not as a CSR add-on, but as the architecture of the business itself.

items.title: Gender equality
items.body: The Yennenga Warriors are a professional women-led talent pipeline prepared to participate across BaSuka's expanding energy ecosystem.

items.title: Affordable & clean energy
items.body: Four utility-scale thermal power plants delivering 130 MW of new dispatchable capacity establish the reliable foundation for an integrated energy ecosystem.

items.title: Decent work & economic growth
items.body: Reliable generation, local workforce development, and smart infrastructure support industrialization, job creation, and long-term economic resilience.

items.title: Climate action
items.body: High-efficiency, lower-emission technologies and environmental and social safeguards will guide responsible development of the platform.

sections.heading: Immediate priorities
sections.intro: The Read-Ahead sets out the practical steps for establishing the generation foundation and preparing the integrated ecosystem.

items.title: Advance generation development
items.body: Advance the development of four thermal power plants totaling 130 MW of new capacity.

items.title: Secure strategic partnerships
items.body: Secure fuel, technology, engineering, financing, and public-sector partnerships.

items.title: Develop the workforce
items.body: Establish workforce solutions and train the first cohorts of Yennenga Warriors.

items.title: Prepare ecosystem expansion
items.body: Prepare the operating foundation for smart-grid, storage, swappable-battery, and clean-mobility expansion.

sections.heading: Build dependable power and inclusive economic growth
sections.body: BaSuka welcomes infrastructure funds and partners who share its commitment to reliable power, responsible development, local capability, and a sovereign energy future for Burkina Faso.
